source_evidence: Many alt funds try to minimize swings in the value of their investments and reduce risks by spreading their investments among different asset types and/or using complex trading strategies.
question: Misconception: An alternative mutual fund that spreads its investments across different asset types eliminates investment risk.
answer: Spreading investments across different asset types may help reduce risk and minimize swings, but the source says these funds try to do so—it does not say diversification eliminates risk. Alternative mutual funds can also have additional risks from their strategies.
